campaigns.title: Activation: signed up, no first result in 48h

steps.subject: Your first result is closer than you think
steps.body: One small step is usually enough to see whether this is for you.

steps.subject: You signed up - here is the fastest first win
steps.body:
Hi! The quickest way to see if this is for you: open the product and finish one small thing. {{app_url}}

Stuck on anything? Reply to this email - a person reads it.

steps.subject: The one thing that usually blocks people
steps.body:
Most people who stall stop at the same spot: they open the product, look around, and close it without trying anything. The fix is to start smaller than feels useful - one tiny result changes how the whole product reads. {{app_url}}

If something specific is in your way, reply with one line and we will sort it.

steps.subject: Did we get something wrong?
steps.body:
You signed up but never got to a first result - that is usually on us, not you. What stopped you? Reply with one line, even two words help.

Your account is ready whenever you are: {{app_url}}

campaigns.title: Trial ends in <=3 days, not paid

steps.subject: Your trial ends soon - keep what you made
steps.body: Everything you made and set up stays with you on any paid plan.

steps.subject: Your trial ends in a few days - here is what you keep
steps.body:
When you upgrade, everything you made and every setting carries over - nothing to redo. Plans start small and you can change or cancel anytime: {{app_url}}

Not sure which plan fits? Reply and a person will tell you honestly, including if the smallest one is enough.

steps.subject: Still deciding? Tell us what is holding you back
steps.body: Your work and settings stay with you on any paid plan. If something held you back from upgrading - price, a missing feature, not enough time to test - reply with one line. A human reads this and answers honestly. {{app_url}}

steps.subject: Your trial ended - nothing was deleted
steps.body:
The trial is over, but your work and settings are all still here. Pick a plan and everything is exactly where you left it: {{app_url}}

If you tried it and it was not a fit, no hard feelings - a one-line reply about why helps us more than you would think.

steps.subject: Payment issue - action needed
steps.body: Your last payment did not go through. Update your card - it takes 30 seconds, your work is safe.

steps.subject: Payment issue - your account is safe
steps.body:
Your last payment did not go through - usually the card expired, hit a limit, or the bank asked for extra confirmation. Nothing is wrong on your side of the product and your work is safe.

Updating the card takes about 30 seconds: {{card_update_url}}

steps.subject: Reminder: your card is still declining
steps.body:
Quick reminder - your payment method still needs an update: {{card_update_url}}

The charge retries automatically once it is fixed, nothing else to do.

steps.subject: Your subscription will pause if the card keeps declining
steps.body: The card has been declined several times now. If it stays that way, the subscription pauses - your data stays safe, but access stops. Updating takes 30 seconds and everything continues as if nothing happened: {{card_update_url}}

steps.subject: Two weeks unpaid - your data is still safe
steps.body:
Your subscription is on hold, nothing has been deleted. One card update brings everything back exactly as it was: {{card_update_url}}

If you meant to cancel instead, just ignore this - we will stop reminding soon.

steps.subject: Last reminder - then we stop emailing about this
steps.body: This is the final reminder about the payment that did not go through. If it was deliberate, ignore this - otherwise your account restarts in one click: {{card_update_url}}

campaigns.title: Save: activity dropped or cancel flow started

steps.subject: Need a break? Pause instead of canceling
steps.body: Take a break: history and settings stay, you pay nothing while it is paused, it resumes when you are ready.

steps.subject: Take a month off instead of canceling
steps.body:
If now is just a busy or tight moment, pause the subscription: you pay nothing while it is paused, your history and settings stay, and it picks up when you are ready. {{app_url}}

If it is something else - price, a missing feature, something broken - reply with one line. A person reads this.

steps.subject: One question before you go
steps.body:
If you are stepping away, what is the main reason? One line is enough - it decides what we fix next.

If it is price or timing, there may be an option we have not shown you - just ask. {{app_url}}

campaigns.title: Upgrade: power user at plan limit

steps.subject: You are close to your plan limit
steps.body: Heavy month. The next tier gives you headroom and a lower cost per unit.

steps.subject: You are hitting your plan limit this month
steps.body:
You have used most of your plan - which usually means the product is earning its keep. The next tier removes the ceiling for months like this one, and often works out cheaper per unit - the pricing page has the exact math: {{app_url}}

Want a sanity check on which tier actually fits your usage? Reply - a person will look at your numbers.

steps.subject: Worth checking: annual pricing for months like this
steps.body: If months like this one are the new normal, annual billing usually works out cheaper for the same thing - the exact math is on the pricing page: {{app_url}}

steps.subject: Your account is still here (untouched)
steps.body: It has been a few weeks since you canceled. Your account and history are exactly as you left them, so a fresh look costs nothing: {{app_url}}

steps.subject: What made you leave?
steps.body:
Honest question, one line is enough: what was the main reason you canceled? It goes straight into what we build next.

And if that reason is already fixed - your account is still here: {{app_url}}

steps.subject: Last note from us
steps.body: This is the last email - we do not believe in nagging people who made a decision. Your account and history stay saved, and if you ever want to pick up where you left off, the door is open: {{app_url}}

steps.subject: Your upgrade is one click from done
steps.body: You started checking out and stopped - whatever got in the way, your plan is still waiting.

steps.subject: You were one step from your plan
You have used your credits - do not lose momentum
steps.body: You clearly found your rhythm: the balance is at {{credits_left}}. Top up or upgrade to keep going.

steps.subject: Out of credits mid-flow?
Your card expires soon - 30 seconds to keep everything running
steps.body:
Hi! The card on your subscription expires at the end of the month. Updating it takes about 30 seconds and nothing gets interrupted: {{card_update_url}}

After it expires the renewal fails silently - this is exactly the kind of loss nobody notices until access stops.

steps.subject: Card update pending
steps.body: Your payment card expires this month. Update it to keep your subscription running.
